reason: Extend F08-05 using aggregate statistics from the authors' two published laboratory experiments; preserve prior pilots.
source_table: Table1, printed page700, final two columns
partition: Reconstruct unique integer counts compatible with four-decimal proportions and sample sizes; allocate half of each order group's response tokens randomly to fitting, remainder to evaluation.
data_limit: Published aggregates, not new or private individual records. Token indices are artificial, not participant IDs. Repeated partitions are not independent replications or extra human participants.
primary_metric: held-partition negative log-likelihood per response on identical evidence
comparison: Report both models, full-data fit and all partitions. Equivalent classical model is a strong null and should tie numerically.
model_fit_diagnostic: Full-data maximum absolute joint-probability residual above0.10 flags the restricted model for rejection, without a population-level p-value.
interpretation_limit: A 2D real pure-state model is narrower than general quantum cognition. Poor fit does not refute the original paper's higher-dimensional model. Good fit is not proof of a quantum brain or superior invention.
reserved_policy: No F00 reserved benchmark is opened.
